$comment: Single source of truth for build/debug flags and presets. Edit flags and presets HERE. Consumed by the build-flags picker extension and by tools/build/generate_flag_configs (which regenerates the static fallback launch configs). Every flag's 'define' should be a real -D toggle, i.e. it appears in code/_compile_options.dm or is consumed by tools/build/build.ts (e.g. ALL_TEMPLATES).

flags.label: Testing
flags.description: Enables testing() debug messages. Also turns on DATUMVAR_DEBUGGING_MODE, atmos/lighting update visualisers and max-share tracking.

flags.label: Reagents testing
flags.description: Debug messages for every reaction step (very spammy). Requires TESTING.

flags.label: Map test mode
flags.description: Disables common annoyances (rat spawns, random light breakage) so mappers can test without shenanigans.

flags.label: Low memory mode
flags.description: Forces runtimestation for a quicker compilation cycle.

flags.label: Absolute minimum
flags.description: Forces runtimestation_minimal, the smallest possible map.

flags.label: Timer debug
flags.description: Compiles full timer debug info. Warning: increases timer creation cost ~5x.

flags.label: Reference tracking (live)
flags.description: Sets up the ref tracker for a live environment, logging hard-deletes to harddels.log. Uses fast reftracking but less accurate.

flags.label: Reference tracking (standard)
flags.description: Local hard-deletion hunting. Spends all its time searching (slower but thorough), logging to harddels.log.

flags.label: Datum var debugging
flags.description: Caches datum vars so you can retrieve them later to see which vars changed. Implied by TESTING.

flags.label: Unit tests
flags.description: Runs all unit tests, then shuts down.

flags.label: byond-tracy profiler
flags.description: Attempts to load prof.dll/libprof.so on boot for Tracy profiling. You must build byond-tracy yourself look at the guide for info.

flags.label: byond-tracy MC tab info
flags.description: Displays byond-tracy's status in the MC tab.

flags.label: Performance tests
flags.description: Boots, runs world.run_performance_tests(), then shuts down the server.

flags.label: Do not defer assets
flags.description: Generates all assets up front during initialize instead of deferring them when needed.

flags.label: Profile mapload init atom
flags.description: Profiles atom initialization during map load.

flags.label: Verb stress test
flags.description: Forces verb processing into just the 2% of a tick we normally reserve for it, for simulating highpop.

flags.label: Force verb overtime
flags.description: Forces all verbs to run into overtime all of the time, negating the reserve 2%.

flags.label: All templates
flags.description: Includes all map templates in the build (needed for some map/ruin testing).
